title: Мы не того взяли  (We Grabbed the Wrong Man)

segments.t: In the storage room, Max proudly announces to Vika that he and Kostya have captured the hypnotist and are interrogating him. When Vika peels the tape off the prisoner's face, she is horrified to see one of the members of the hotel inspection commission.
Я же сказала, не лезь не в своё дело!
Костян, походу, мы не того взяли.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'What is happening?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'is happening'. Max answers right away.
'Vika, do not be nervous.' Max anchors the line on 'Vika', while 'be nervous' completes the thought.
'We caught the hypnotist.' The grammar packs 'we' and 'hypnotist' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'We are interrogating him right now. Here are his things.' The meaning hinges on 'now' working together with 'thing' in spoken Russian. Vika answers right away.
Я же сказала, не лезь не в своё дело!
'I told you, do not meddle in what is none of your business!' Vika anchors the line on 'I', while 'business' completes the thought.
'This is an inspector from the commission!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'this' and finishing on 'commission'.
'Maxim, you are an exceptional person!' Here Vika anchors the thought on 'exceptional' and finishes on 'a man, a person', keeping the spoken rhythm brisk and natural.
Костян, походу, мы не того взяли.
'Kostyan, it looks like we grabbed the wrong guy.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Kostyan' before landing on 'took'.
'What should we do now?' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'to do' without extra filler words.
'Untie him!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'untie' and finishing on 'his'. Kostya answers right away.
'Why me?' Kostya anchors the line on 'why', while 'I' completes the thought.
'Untie him faster!' The grammar packs 'faster' and 'untie' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я же сказала, не лезь не в своё дело!
Костян, походу, мы не того взяли.
That brings the storage-room blunder to a close. Listen for Vika scolding Max not to meddle in other people's business and Max ordering Kostya to untie the inspector. See you next time!
